rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a professional who provides therapy, especially physical, occupational, or speech therapy.

example.english: I sprained my ankle, so I saw a therapist for physical therapy.
example.traditional: 我細個扭親隻腳，去見治療師做物理治療。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 nau2 can1 zek3 goek3 heoi3 gin3 zi6 liu4 si1 zou6 mat6 lei5 zi6 liu4

rows.note: Use this specifically for someone who provides psychotherapy rather than physical or rehabilitation therapy.

example.english: I have not been sleeping well lately, so I made an appointment with a therapist to talk.
example.traditional: 最近成日瞓唔着，我約咗心理治療師傾吓。
example.jyutping: zeoi3 gan6 seng4 jat6 fan3 m4 zoek6 ngo5 joek3 zo2 sam1 lei5 zi6 liu4 si1 king1 haa2
